question: Should cumulative session cost in status use a bounded/precomputed aggregate before https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94308 can land, or may status perform full transcript scans for exact cost?
rationale: The requested feature is valuable, but the active implementation has a maintainer-visible tradeoff between exact transcript totals and keeping routine status output responsive for long sessions.

options.title: Require bounded status cost
options.body: Continue with the linked PR only after it uses a bounded read, cached aggregate, or maintained aggregate for default status paths.

options.title: Accept exact full scans
options.body: Allow full transcript scans in status for exact cumulative cost and document the responsiveness tradeoff.

options.title: Defer to broader usage work
options.body: Leave this issue open until the cost/usage aggregation architecture settles in a separate canonical effort.

recommendation.title: Require bounded status cost
recommendation.body: Continue with the linked PR only after it uses a bounded read, cached aggregate, or maintained aggregate for default status paths.

likelyOwner.reason: Their status fast-path commit is the clearest historical signal for the responsiveness constraint now blocking the active implementation.
